name: Apparition Legion
main_effect: [Main] By returning 9 levels' total worth of Digimon cards from your opponent's trash to the bottom of the deck, you may play 1 [Ghost] trait Digimon card of each returned card's level from your trash without paying the costs. Then, the Digimon this effect played gain ＜Rush＞ (This Digimon can attack the turn it comes into play.) and ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.) until the end of your opponent's turn.
source_effect: Security Effect [Security] You may play 1 level 5 or lower Digimon card with the [Ghost] trait from your trash without paying the cost.
